title: bug: both mods' tracked tsconfig.json set no compilerOptions and take noEmit only from the gitignored, engine-written .claude-plugin/types/tsconfig.json, so `tsc -p` in any task worktree or snapshot fails with TS5083 and writes register.js/register.test.js beside the sources, which then land (d27edf88's 5265909c: +1118 lines, QA reject 08:30Z 11-04)
description:
Filed by the governor (governor-e6142a94) on 2026-11-04 after the QA reject of task-d27edf88 (#governors ❌ msg-7a680d57, 08:30Z).

PROBLEM
- scripts/mods/moe-account-switch/tsconfig.json and scripts/mods/moe-compaction-keeper/tsconfig.json contain only `{ "extends": "./.claude-plugin/types/tsconfig.json" }`.
- That base is engine-written and gitignored (.gitignore:100 `scripts/mods/*/.claude-plugin/types/`). It is the only place `"noEmit": true` is set.
- In worktree mode every seat edits in .worktrees/<taskId>, and verifies in git-archive snapshots. The base is absent from all of them: the governor checked all 8 current worktrees and none has it.
- Governor repro at 3747c474, in a git-archive snapshot of scripts/mods with classic tsc 7.0.2 (moe-vscode/node_modules): `tsc -p scripts/mods/moe-account-switch/tsconfig.json` reports `TS5083: Cannot read file .../.claude-plugin/types/tsconfig.json` plus TS2307 and TS5097, and still writes hooks/register.js and hooks/register.test.js.
- That is how d27edf88's completion 5265909c landed both files (+300 and +818 lines, over the 400 net-LOC cap) and drew a QA reject. hooks.json loads ./register.ts, so the .js files are dead code. register.test.js also escapes the IDE bundles' `*.test.ts` exclusion (scripts/CLAUDE.md:41).

FIX
- Add `"compilerOptions": { "noEmit": true }` to both tracked tsconfig.json files and keep the extends.
- Governor check in the same snapshot: with that line, tsc writes nothing even when the base is missing. With the control checkout's base copied in, the account-switch type check reports exactly the planned baseline (TS5097 and TS2769 in register.test.ts) and still emits nothing.

SCOPE
- The two tsconfig.json files only.
- The deletion of the already-landed register.js and register.test.js belongs to task-d27edf88's rework (its step-4 was amended at 08:3xZ). Do not touch scripts/mods/moe-account-switch/hooks/.
- Out of scope: making the type check resolve its types inside a worktree, for example by having the launchers copy .claude-plugin/types into new worktrees. Mention it in the completion summary if you think it is worth a row.

VERIFY
- In a git-archive snapshot outside the shared checkout, run `tsc -p` for each mod, without the base and then with the base copied in from $MOE_PROJECT_PATH. Both runs must write no .js file.
- Then run `claude plugin test scripts/mods/moe-account-switch` and `claude plugin test scripts/mods/moe-compaction-keeper` under `env -i PATH="$PATH" HOME="$HOME" CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR="$(mktemp -d)"`.
definitionOfDone: Both scripts/mods/*/tsconfig.json files keep their extends and set compilerOptions.noEmit true. In a snapshot without .claude-plugin/types/, `tsc -p` on each mod writes no .js file, and the completion summary quotes the listing.

With the control checkout's base copied into the snapshot, each mod's type check reports the same errors as before the change (moe-account-switch: TS5097 and TS2769 only) and writes nothing. `claude plugin test` passes for both mods.
The diff changes only the two tsconfig.json files.
